tasks.CalculateAnnualSalesLastYear: Calculate the total number of microwave ovens sold in the last year based on the average monthly sales.
tasks.CalculateAverageMonthlySales22Months: Calculate the average monthly sales for the entire 22-month period based on the total sales.
tasks.CalculateFirst10MonthsThisYear: Calculate the total number of microwave ovens sold in the first 10 months of this year based on the average monthly sales.
tasks.CalculateTotalSales22Months: Calculate the total number of microwave ovens sold over the 22-month period by summing the annual and partial-year sales.
